context: Adds tracing spans to the order creation and cancellation handlers.
explanation: Both handlers get a #[instrument] span with skip(pool, items) to avoid expensive/irrelevant Debug-formatting of the pool handle and full item list, plus structured fields (customer_id, item_count, order_id) so these code paths are correlated and filterable in production tracing. Completion events log structured fields rather than interpolating values into a message string, keeping them queryable in a structured log backend.
